title: capacity buffer drain and soft-quota hits during weekend traffic surge
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Summary: During a sustained weekend surge (Sat 03/07 — Sun 03/08) we observed a cross-tenant degradation where several Dedicated customers hit soft quota limits and saw elevated 429 and 503 responses. Root cause: the reserved-pool buffer (soft headroom) was drained by an atypical traffic pattern and burst-credit replenishment did not keep pace because the replenishment logic only ran on a fixed interval and skipped reconciliation while an allocator leadership handoff was in progress. This ticket tracks the investigation, temporary mitigations we applied, and a proposed permanent fix to make replenishment event-driven and to harden accounting across leadership changes.
reproduction_steps: Simulate 2x baseline sustained burst from multiple tenants against the same reserved pool for 30+ minutes using load-generator (scripts/loadburst.sh)
Observe pool_headroom_v2 and burst_credits_available metrics in Grafana (dashboard: Dedicated > Pool Utilization) — headroom decreases to zero within ~18 minutes in this pattern
Force a leader election for the allocator (kubectl rollout restart deployment/allocator) while burst is ongoing to reproduce replenishment gap
Confirm 429 spike on affected tenants and increased request queuing latency in Istio traces
investigation_notes: 03/08 02:15 - Initial alert: paging for 'high 429 rate' from NYC region on dedicated pool pool-07
03/08 02:22 - Confirmed correlation between 429s and pool_headroom_v2==0 across tenants sharing pool-07
03/08 02:40 - Replenishment job (burst-credit-reconciler) logs show skipped runs during allocation-leader-transition window (see log excerpt: reconciler: skipped - no-leader)
03/08 03:00 - Hypothesis: fixed-interval reconciler + leader handoff race caused delayed refills that allowed consumer-side soft quotas to transition to hard throttle enforcement
Metric observations: burst_credit_replenish_latency P95 increased from 120ms -> 9.8s during windows of allocation contention

Edge case discovered: if replenisher misses 2 consecutive ticks, the downstream soft-quota state machine flips into 'protective throttle' which takes an extra tick to clear even after credits restored
temporary_mitigation: 03/08 03:10 - Emergency action: increased soft-quota threshold for affected tenants in pool-07 via console (operator override) to provide immediate headroom
03/08 03:28 - Manually triggered burst-credit-reconciler job to refill credits (kubectl -n infra exec job/burst-credit-reconciler -- /app/reconcile --pool pool-07)
03/08 04:00 - Rolled a canary of allocator with reduced leader-election window and added a short-term backoff skip prevention flag
Customer comms: Sent targeted notifications to impacted customers with ETA and mitigation steps (see links)
permanent_fix_plan: Make replenishment event-driven: trigger reconcile on pool-level delta (utilization spike) in addition to fixed ticks
Update replenisher to be idempotent across leader handoffs (persist reconciliation cursor to etcd) to avoid skipped windows
Change soft-quota state machine so it requires explicit reconciliation confirmation before flipping to protective throttle
Add unit + integration tests for replenisher under leader-election scenarios and simulated clock drift
Post-deploy: run a controlled chaos job that injects leader-election events while applying synthetic bursts to validate resiliency
rollout_plan: Feature branch and PR (GH: redwood-inference/allocator#PR-4821) — have tests green
Canary deploy to staging and then to a single non-critical Dedicated pool for 48 hours
Gradual rollout across regions with monitoring thresholds: if 429 rate > 0.2% and pool headroom < 5% trigger automatic rollback
Coordinated release window: off-peak weekday (Wed 03/18 02:00 UTC) with on-call and SRE present
Post-rollout verification runbook: run synthetic bursts and leader-election scenarios for 6 hours
testing_notes: Added integration harness test 'replenisher_leader_handoff_test' that simulates missed ticks and validates idempotent cursor behavior
Load test config: 25 tenants, each 500 RPS for 30 minutes, with random leader-election 'kill' events every 5-10 minutes
Performance target: replenisher P99 < 500ms under contention; current improvement measured on bench: P99 -> 420ms after code change
Quality gates: must maintain no increase in coldstart latency or allocation churn beyond 1% during test window
